events.title: Bloom Energy disclosed Oracle and Nebius data-center deployment and contracted-capacity updates
events.canonical_summary: Between 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-15, Bloom Energy disclosed Oracle and Nebius commercial relationships, Oracle data-center fuel-cell deployment, and approximately 1.2 GW of contracted capacity being deployed across U.S. projects.
events.known_event_summary: During 2026-09-09–09-15, Bloom described major Oracle/Nebius deals, Oracle data-center fuel-cell deployment, and 1.2 GW of contracted capacity being deployed across U.S. projects.

facts.proposition: Bloom Energy has major deals with Oracle and Nebius.
Bloom Energy named Oracle as its first direct hyperscaler customer.
Bloom Energy committed to providing power at Oracle's first data center within 90 days.
Bloom Energy will deliver power-generation solutions to some of Oracle's data centers.
Clay Magouyrk stated that using Bloom Energy fuel cells is the most environmentally friendly way to generate power.
Oracle is using Bloom Energy fuel cells for on-site power at its New Mexico data center.
An initial 1.2 GW of capacity is contracted and being deployed across U.S. projects.
